contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GLORIA EXERCITVS ; D/ CONSTANS PF AVG

A copper Alloy Nummus, of Constans (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads: GLORIA EXERCITVS. Reverse shows Two soldiers and one standard. Mint is Trier AD 340-341. See RIC, VIII, p145 no 111. Obverse Legend reads: CONSTANS PF AVG. Obverse: Rosette diademed, draped and cuirassed bust facing right. Reverse fields and exergue reads: M//TRP upturned crescent. Die axis is 12 o'clock
